title: txnbuild: NewFeeBumpTransaction with a v0 inner transaction returns a fee bump whose inner transaction is nil, so Base64() and Hash() panic

target.versions_affected: v0.6.0 - v0.9.0 (the code involved is the same in every tag; executed on v0.7.1 and v0.9.0) and main 4cee0255

severity_basis: NewFeeBumpTransaction builds the fee-bump envelope from the inner envelope read before convertToV1, so for an ENVELOPE_TYPE_TX_V0 inner transaction InnerTx.V1 is nil and Base64(), MarshalBinary() and Hash() panic; convertToV1 also refuses a v0 transaction without time bounds and changes the inner hash when the fee is not a multiple of the operation count. In practice the API cannot fee-bump a v0 transaction; a panic or a refusal, no wrong value reaches the network.

entries.expected: NewFeeBumpTransaction over a parsed v0 transaction gives a fee bump whose inner transaction is the signed transaction, and the fee bump encodes and hashes
entries.observed: No conformance fact of the kit fee-bumps a parsed transaction. By hand on v0.9.0: for a v0 transaction with time bounds, fee 300 and 3 operations, the fee-bump envelope has InnerTx.V1 == nil and fb.Base64(), fb.MarshalBinary() and fb.HashHex() panic with a nil pointer dereference.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's standalone program on v0.9.0, main 4cee0255 and v0.7.1: NewFeeBumpTransaction returns no error, the envelope's InnerTx.V1 is nil, and Base64(), MarshalBinary() and HashHex() panic; a v0 transaction without time bounds is refused, and fee 301 for 3 operations becomes 300 with a different inner hash.
evidence.expected_basis: stellar-core converts a v0 transaction to v1 field by field (txbridge::convertForV13), with PRECOND_TIME or PRECOND_NONE and the same fee, so the hash and the signatures stay valid (CAP-15).

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 before filing on 2026-11-19: the fee bump of a v0 transaction panics when encoded.
